name: Amlogic (Shanghai) Co.,Ltd.
summary: Amlogic (Shanghai) Co.,Ltd., a fabless semiconductor system design manufacturer, engages in the research, design, development, and sale of system-on-a-chip (SoC) and peripheral chips in China and internationally. The company offers intelligent multimedia and display SoCs, artificial intelligence of things (AIoT) SoCs, communication and connectivity chips, smart car SoCs, and other chips. Its products are used in smart homes, commercial, industrial, mobility, entertainment, education, gaming systems, sports, fitness, and agricultural applications.
